about_the_game:
You are the last guardian and the final hope of your people, as the shadows of darkness spread across the land. Strengthen your hero with character traits, abilities, and powerful relics. Each run offers new builds, new choices, and new fates.

But your true power lies in your backpack. Every item you carry can alter your destiny. Strategically position and rotate items of varying sizes to maximize limited space. Items interact with their neighbors, creating unique synergies, amplifying stats, or unlocking hidden effects. Some spells must be inserted into weapons or armor to be unleashed, while others are strengthened by adjacent items.

Ascend through the randomly generated map by choosing your path, starting at the bottom and moving upward. Encounter diverse challenges like enemies, elites, treasure chests, campfires, merchants, and more. Plan your journey wisely!
Choose your path through procedurally generated maps filled with enemies, elites, merchants, cursed shrines, and hidden treasures. Between battles, craft new equipment, gamble with blessings and curses, and adapt your strategy to survive the climb through three deadly Acts.

Every run is different - new loot, new talents, new challenges. How far can you ascend?
 

Features

  • Backpack Synergies - Items influence neighboring gear. Position and rotate your loot to unlock hidden bonuses and game-changing multipliers.

  • Spells & Attunements - Socket powerful spells into weapons, armor, or jewellery to unleash unique abilities.

  • Procedural Talent Trees - Every run generates a character progression path. No two builds are ever the same.

  • Endless Loot Variety - Discover procedurally generated items with affixes, blessings, curses, attunements, and crafting upgrades.

  • Weapons & Playstyles - Fight with bows, swords, staffs and many more weapons to come! Each weapons suggests different playstyle!

  • Crafting & Rare Finds - Merge crafting materials, discover runes, and seek out hidden merchants to forge unique equipment.

  • Dynamic Combat - Manage mana and stamina while dodging, blocking, and striking in fast-paced encounters against enemies with unique mechanics.

  • Randomized Adventures - Explore three Acts of branching paths with enemies, elites, campfires, treasures, and secret encounters.

  • Replay Without End - With randomized loot, talent trees, and maps, every run tells a different story.

name: Backpack Guardian

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 580 / AMD HD 7870
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4670K / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 / AMD HD 7970
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Discover powerful items and unleash devastating spells, but remember - your backpack is your greatest weapon! Strategically arrange your inventory to boost bonuses, stack multipliers and then defeat the approaching dark forces in this Roguelike adventure.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Bulgarian, Polish, Russian, Ukrainian
